sloka: सा वेपमाना लज्जन्ती भीता करकृताञ्जलिः ।नलकूबरमासाद्य पादयोर्निपपात ह ।। ७.२६.४५ ॥
transliteration: sā vepamānā lajjantī bhītā karakṛtāñjaliḥ ।nalakūbaramāsādya pādayornipapāta ha ।। 7.26.45 ॥

translations.english: Trembling, ashamed, and frightened, she approached Nalakubara with folded hands and fell at his feet.
